subject: Error due to unordered factor with more than 2 levels

messages.author: a1e5ab842cd91cf5
messages.subject: Error due to unordered factor with more than 2 levels
parts:
Hi,

I'm working on generating a simple SEM model for my neuroimaging data, where I have mean activation of individual brain areas. I want to compare the brain activity between three groups (2 patient groups and one healthy control group) along with the indirect effect of anxiety scores. the command is this-

semodel<- 'HARS~a*Group
            LAm~b*HARS + c*Group
            indirect:=a*b
            total:=c+indirect'
fitsem<- sem(semodel, data = df)
summary(fitsem, standardized=TRUE,ci=TRUE, fit.measures=TRUE) 

However, I'm getting an error as- Error in lav_data_full(data = data, group = group, cluster = cluster, :
lavaan ERROR: unordered factor(s) with more than 2 levels detected as exogenous covariate(s): Group
I assume this is because of the three levels in the factor. I tried making the model multilevel by adding "cluster" and am still getting a similar error. Any insight on where I might be going wrong?

Navya

messages.subject: Re: Error due to unordered factor with more than 2 levels
parts:
You need to create your own dummy codes (or whatever contrasts codes you want). 

https://lavaan.ugent.be/tutorial/cat.html
